content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: The terms 'Property' and 'Premises' shall hereinafter refer to the residential unit located at 123 Elm Street, Springfield.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_TERM_AND_RENT
content_blocks.text: The term of this Lease shall commence on November 1, 2024, and end on October 31, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein. Tenant agrees to pay rent of $1,200 per month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_REPAIRS
content_blocks.text: Landlord shall promptly repair any defects in the Property that affect Tenant's use and enjoyment thereof, subject to Tenant's prompt reporting of such defects.
